en: A vintage monochrome postcard view of a broad town square lined with trees and surrounding buildings, with groups of people standing and children playing in the open space. In the background rises a church complex with a tall clock tower and spire. The caption at the bottom reads in German that this is the parade ground with church in Torgau, and the printing credit notes Brück & Sohn, Meissen, 1904.
